tool.name: datav-describe-dataset
tool.description:
Describe a dataset's fields and input parameters.
Returns JSON with: - sid / dsName / description / dsType - fields: array of field metadata parsed from dsMeta (name, type, label when available) - params: array of input parameter definitions parsed from dsConfig (name, type, required, defaultValue when available)
Use this after datav-list-datasets to learn which fields the dataset returns and which params the SQL expects (as ${paramName} placeholders) before calling datav-query-dataset. If the dataset does not exist, returns a JSON error object.
